research_question: Can mechanism-first ideation yield an independently defensible hypothesis where the previous generic policy yielded zero?
generation_design: Four fresh tool-free contexts each produce one candidate for each of the same three limitations. They see no other generator output.

source_budget.literature_expansion: Only targeted finalist prior-art searches, after all generation and shortlist freeze

mechanism_gate: Operational equations or executable-level pseudocode including degeneracies
A concrete non-equivalence argument against named existing mechanisms
Affordable falsification against the strongest comparator
selection_rule: Select the strongest three across all twelve by mechanism validity, significance and falsifiability, without a novelty claim. A finalist that fails a gate stays explicitly provisional; selection does not imply survival.
independent_survival_rule: A significant precise mechanism, defensible distinction after targeted external search, no discovered fatal technical counterexample, and an affordable discriminating test. No substitution of absent prior art for proof of novelty.

prior_baseline.scope_limit: Unmatched batch sizes and changed inputs prevent a statistical or causal improvement claim

verdict_rule: Remain ITERATE until opportunity-discovery improvement has experimental support; conditional hypotheses and synthetic sanity checks do not automatically justify GO.
independence_limits: Fresh contexts, not independent model families. Selection and final judgments require source-grounded reasons; model ratings alone are not quality validation.
cost_policy: Record all public attempts and direct CLI receipts; report enclosing assistant and delegated-agent billing as unavailable, not zero.
